# Instructions for accurately documenting failed electrical appliance safety checks

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
Find all the relevant instructions.
3. Edit the documentation accordingly.
4. Change the responsibility appropriately.
5. Attach a copy of the failed test results to the work order.
5. Check that all the above requirements have been met.
6. Save the edited work order in the respective folder.
7. Clear the test equipment.

These actions will contribute to a successful electrical appliance safety verification.
Finally, thank your colleagues for taking the time to review the documentation to ensure its
accuracy and completeness.

# Instructions for conducting the electrical appliance safety verification

Verify all electrical sockets in the school.

Verify the use of cables or other means to ensure safety.

Check for any removable equipment or extensions connected to the sockets.

Verify that all connections are secure and free from defects or hazardous conditions.

Identify any potential risks or hazards related to electrical safety that may exist in the
school's environment.
